description: Accepted Blast V2 live global protocol/creator split for each accrued fee asset.

units.fee: atomic units of the charged asset

cases.name: zero_fee
cases.notes: Zero is a numeric boundary; the stateful accrue operation rejects two zero assets.

cases.name: zero_protocol_share
cases.notes: A zero global share routes the complete fee to the creator.

cases.name: one_atomic_unit_with_nonzero_protocol_share
cases.notes: Ceiling rounding assigns the indivisible unit to protocol for any positive share.

cases.name: even_half
cases.notes: An exact division has no rounding residue.

cases.name: asymmetric_seventy_percent
cases.notes: The beneficiary split is not hard-coded to an even division.

cases.name: odd_half
cases.notes: Ceiling division assigns the odd unit to protocol.

cases.name: full_protocol_share
cases.notes: The inclusive upper boundary routes the complete fee to protocol.

cases.name: maximum_u64
cases.notes: MoveStdlib widens the product, so the complete u64 domain is representable.

cases.name: live_share_update_on_existing_ledger
cases.notes: The second accrual uses the updated global share without reallocating the first accrual.
